title: The Lion and the Mouse
author: Aesop
intro: 一头熟睡的狮子放走了吵醒他的小老鼠，小老鼠许诺将来报答他。狮子没想到，有一天救他出来的正是这只微不足道的小老鼠。句子短、生词少，适合刚开始练文章跟打。

paragraphs.en: A Lion was sleeping in the forest. A little Mouse ran over his nose and woke him up.
paragraphs.zh: 一头狮子正在森林里睡觉。一只小老鼠从他的鼻子上跑过，把他弄醒了。

paragraphs.en: The Lion put his big paw on the Mouse and opened his mouth to eat him.
paragraphs.zh: 狮子用大大的爪子按住老鼠，张开嘴巴要把他吃掉。

paragraphs.en: “Please let me go,” said the little Mouse. “I will help you some day.”
paragraphs.zh: 「请放了我吧，」小老鼠说，「总有一天我会报答你的。」

paragraphs.en: The Lion laughed. “You are so small. How can you help me?” But he was kind, so he let the Mouse go.
paragraphs.zh: 狮子笑了。「你这么小，能帮我什么忙呢？」但他心地善良，还是放走了老鼠。

paragraphs.en: A few days later, the Lion was caught in a net. He tried and tried, but he could not get out. He roared and roared.
paragraphs.zh: 几天之后，狮子落进了猎网。他挣扎了一次又一次，却怎么也出不来，只能不停地怒吼。

paragraphs.en: The little Mouse heard him. She ran to the net and began to bite the ropes with her sharp teeth. One by one, the ropes broke.
paragraphs.zh: 小老鼠听见了。她跑到网边，用尖尖的牙齿啃咬绳索。一根接着一根，绳子断了。

paragraphs.en: “You see,” said the Mouse, “even a little mouse can help a big lion.”
paragraphs.zh: 「你看，」老鼠说，「一只小老鼠也能帮上大狮子的忙。」

paragraphs.en: The Lion was free, and the two of them became good friends.
paragraphs.zh: 狮子重获自由，他们俩从此成了好朋友。
